text:
maria: New RFP. Suncrest fintech wants to replace their CompetitorY endpoints. POC scope: adapter+parity eval, security questionnaire, and hosted vs dedicated TCO. They want parity for invoice parsing + function-call reliability.

devon: I'll take SE on this. Clarify: invoice parsing uses structured output (JSON). They need deterministic function-calling to populate fields 100% of the time (or error).

maria: Yes, they emphasized 'deterministic extraction' in the RFP. Traffic profile: ~10 qps steady, 60 burst. Median doc length ~900 tokens. Timeline: 30 days.

kate: For function-call determinism we'll probably need normalization + a strict schema validator in the shim. Also tune sampling temp to 0.0 for extraction tasks. That reduces variability but impacts cost since more tokens may be needed for longer completions.

devon: Noted. I'll run a harness with temp=0 and temp=0.2 to show delta. Also will baseline token consumption per model.

maria: Security asks: Suncrest requires customer-managed KMS, audit logs 18 months, and quarterly compliance reporting. They also sent a 70-question vendor security questionnaire.

sec-team: Redwood standard: SOC2+ISO; Dedicated supports BYOK; Private supports HSM. Hosted does not by default. We'll note where contract amendments are required.

maria: Pricing: they want a clear monthly cost for hosted vs dedicated (3 node min), plus SWAT onboarding cost. Also want an estimate of migration engineering hours for the deep shim approach.

tariq: For the migration hours, estimate 12 dev days + 4 QA days for the shim and integration tests. For a quick-proxy approach it's ~2 dev days.

ops-bot: Smoke deploy scheduled: suncrest-compat -> staging on 2024-02-14T14:00Z :rocket:

devon: Action items: (1) SE to run deterministic extraction tests and share pass-rate matrix (2) Sec to populate questionnaire draft and note required contract exceptions (3) Sales to produce TCO and migration engineering quote.

kate: FYI: tokenization deltas between CompetitorY and Redwood's tokenizer can inflate token counts for certain invoice types (tables) by ~8-15%. We'll include per-prompt token breakdowns in the TCO.

maria: Good. Also, propose migration incentive: first-month dedicated 50% off or a $10k engineering credit. Procurement typically responds well to fixed credits.

devon: I'll post initial extraction pass rates by EOD tomorrow. Need sample invoice bundle from Suncrest.

maria: I'll request the bundle today and loop in their security lead. Thanks team.
